_note: English source for the 29/10/2026 pricing release. New keys and changed keys only. Every key here is applied to all nine premium/locales/*.json files.

changed.webScope: About five to eight agreed pages with a visual treatment tailored to your business, clear enquiry journeys, technical search basics and a responsive build. Includes two rounds of combined design feedback, one correction round, and handover with training. You supply the text and images unless writing or photography is agreed. The number of pages, content work and any integrations set the final quote.
changed.commerceDesc: For stores with unusual ordering rules, custom integrations, complex stock or fulfilment, several customer types or a large migration.
changed.commerceScope: Starts with discovery and a written quotation. Suited to unusual ordering or pricing rules, custom integrations, complex inventory or fulfilment, multiple customer types, substantial data migration or a custom platform. Platform subscriptions, transaction fees and third-party costs are separate.

new.fixDesc: Fix one defined problem on your current website, such as a broken enquiry form, a mobile layout fault or a slow page.
new.fixScope: One agreed problem, assessed on your current website before the price is confirmed. Examples: repairing an enquiry or booking journey, correcting a specific mobile layout fault, or fixing a diagnosed performance issue. It does not include a rebuild, fixing every problem on the site, recovering from a security incident or reaching a particular performance score.
new.auditDesc: A focused check of a small website's search basics, with a short list of fixes in priority order.
new.auditScope: Covers technical search basics, page titles and descriptions, local business details and the most important pages of a small website. You receive a short prioritised list and a walkthrough. Making the fixes is quoted separately. Rankings, traffic and AI citations are not guaranteed.
new.compactDesc: A small, complete website for one clear purpose, such as a menu, a service or a club.
new.compactScope: One substantial page or a few simple pages, built on an established design system adapted to your business. Core service or menu information, contact and location details, a responsive build and essential checks, with one revision round. You supply approved text and images. Photography, substantial writing, extra languages, booking subscriptions and custom integrations are quoted separately.
new.premiumDesc: A deeper website project with original visual direction and planned content.
new.premiumScope: For businesses that need more than a standard site. Depending on the agreed scope it can include original visual direction, content planning, more developed interaction, bilingual content, a configured booking or enquiry workflow, and launch or migration planning. Includes two rounds of combined design feedback and one correction round. The proposal lists exactly which items are included; not every item comes with the lowest price.
new.storeDesc: A professionally designed store on an established commerce platform, set up for your products.
new.storeScope: Storefront setup and adaptation, catalogue structure, setup or import of an agreed number of products, payments supported by the chosen platform, shipping settings, checkout testing and operator training. We check that your payment provider suits the platform before confirming. Platform subscriptions, transaction fees, paid extensions and third-party services are separate unless the proposal includes them. Custom inventory, accounting or fulfilment software is not included.
new.caretechDesc: Monitoring and routine maintenance to keep your website working.
new.caretechScope: Uptime monitoring, routine software and dependency updates, backup checks and a monthly check of forms and email. Content changes and new features are not included. Response targets are confirmed in your proposal; a response target is not a guaranteed fix time. Hosting and third-party costs are separate unless stated.
new.carecontentDesc: Technical care, plus an agreed allowance of small content changes each month.
new.carecontentScope: Everything in Technical care, plus an agreed monthly allowance of small content changes such as menus, prices, text and photos. The allowance is confirmed in your proposal and is not unlimited. New pages, features and campaign work are quoted separately.
new.localsearchDesc: Monthly work on how a local business appears in Google Search and Maps.
new.localsearchScope: An agreed monthly allowance of local search work: Google Business Profile upkeep, improvements to local pages, technical fixes and a short monthly report. Unlimited writing and advertising spend are not included. Rankings, traffic, sales and AI citations are not guaranteed.
new.diagnosticDesc: One question, one meeting and short written recommendations, for a fixed fee.
new.diagnosticScope: One agreed question, preparation agreed in advance, one meeting and concise written recommendations. Implementation, extra preparation and repeated follow-up are not included. If the work needs more than this, we say so before it starts.
new.automateDesc: One task automated: one input, one process, one output.
new.automateScope: A bounded automation, such as a straightforward data transformation, a document-generation step or a handoff between two supported systems. You supply sample data and access; we agree what is tested and hand it over with short instructions. Unrestricted integrations, unlimited data cleanup and ongoing operation are not included. It can use AI where that suits the task.
new.workflowDesc: A bounded workflow with validation, error handling and documentation.
new.workflowScope: More than a single script: input checks, error handling, logging where needed, documentation and an agreed handover. Smaller than a full business application: no new user accounts, roles or custom interface unless agreed. Model usage and third-party subscriptions are separate.
new.pilotDesc: A first working version of an internal tool for one core workflow.
new.pilotScope: One core workflow with straightforward data, a small agreed set of user roles and suitable permissions, testing and handover. A pilot is tested and usable for its agreed workflow; it is not the full system. Regulated-data requirements, large migrations, access for several organisations and difficult integrations are not included.
new.scopeIntroEngagement: Fixed price for an agreed question and preparation. Implementation is quoted separately.
new.pg_web_lead: From a compact site for one clear purpose to a larger project with original direction. Choose the size that fits the job.
new.pg_commerce_lead: A configured store on an established platform for most shops, or bespoke commerce when your ordering, stock or integrations need it.
new.pg_care_lead: Keep your website working after launch, with or without monthly content updates.
new.pg_seo_lead: Find out what helps people discover your website, starting with a small-site audit.
new.pg_search_lead: Ongoing search work, sized for a local business or a larger content campaign.
new.pg_consult_lead: Get a clear answer to one question for a fixed fee, or specialist advice by the hour. Sending an enquiry does not start any charge.
new.pg_automation_lead: Automate one repetitive task, or a whole workflow with checks and error handling.
new.pg_app_lead: Start with a pilot for one workflow, then build the full system once it has proved useful.
new.grp_improve_intro: Fix a defined problem, or find out what is holding your current site back.
new.grp_build_intro: From a compact site to a larger project. The scope sets the price.
new.grp_sell_intro: A configured store for most shops. Bespoke commerce when the rules are unusual.
new.grp_grow_intro: Optional monthly care and search plans. You can also update agreed content yourself.
new.grp_understand_intro: Get a clear answer before you commit to a build.
new.grp_automate_intro: Remove a repetitive step, or automate a whole workflow.
new.grp_system_intro: Start with a pilot, then grow it into the full system.
new.grp_run_intro: Monitoring, maintenance and support once the system is live.
new.tiersTitle: Choose the size of the job
new.tiersIntro: Each option has a defined scope. Your proposal confirms what is included and the final price.
new.autoStepError: Anything that fails a check is flagged, not passed on.
new.enquiryNoCharge: Sending an enquiry is free and commits you to nothing. Work and billing start only after you accept a written proposal.

online-store.question: Can you build an online store?
online-store.answer: Yes. Most shops suit a configured store on an established commerce platform: storefront, products, payments, shipping and training, quoted from {store}. Unusual ordering rules, custom integrations or complex stock and fulfilment need bespoke commerce, which starts with discovery and a written quotation. Platform subscriptions and transaction fees are separate.

existing-website.question: Can you fix or replace my existing website?
existing-website.answer: Yes. Share the link and what is not working. A single defined problem can often be fixed as a website improvement from {fix}; a wider problem may need a rebuild. Domain access, existing email, important URLs and search redirects are included in any migration scope before switching.
